result.brief: ViDAL 提出以未来视觉动态为锚点的动作潜空间，通过 Action VAE 对齐动作块与场景未来动态，作为可插拔动作接口提升 VLA 策略并支持可选未来视频预测。
result.reason: Action VAE latent aligned with future visual dynamics; representation contribution for VLA policies, with optional future-video prediction. Main contribution is robot policy, so secondary world-model application.
